question: _______, the newly elected Prime Minister of Somalia, took office in September 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohamed Hussein Roble.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohamed Hussein Roble is the newly elected Prime Minister of Somalia, took office in September 2020.**

 
• Somali president Hassan Sheikh Mohamud on 15 June 2022 appointed Hamza Abdi Barre as the country's Prime Minister.
 
• Barre is an MP from the semi-autonomous state of Jubaland and will replace Mohamed Hussein Roble.
 
• Barre was also the secretary-general of the Peace and Development Party.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​Somalia,** officially the Federal Republic of Somalia, is a country in the Horn of Africa.
 
• The country is bordered by Ethiopia to the west, Djibouti to the northwest, the Gulf of Aden to the north, the Indian Ocean to the east, and Kenya to the southwest.
 
• Somalia has the longest coastline on Africa's mainland.
 
• Somalia:
 
 
• Somalia Capital - Mogadishu
 
• Somalia Currency - Somali shilling
